_doc: Pontifex bundle pin (PROGRAMME-PRESERVATION-PROTOCOL §0.6 / AGENTS.md Rule 4). Declares the Codex-published substrate this MCP serves. Values under `inputs` and `kg_surface` are verified against the bundle's own manifests in data/. The KG release tag + sha256 are Codex-owned and PENDING (co-design 2026-06-11) — never invented here. Maintained by scripts/verify-consumed-bundle.mjs (run in `npm run check`).

kg_bundle.tag_scheme_codesign: OPEN (Codex 2026-06-11): dual tag schemes — vX.Y.Z (semver product channel) vs kg-v1-*-aligned (cycle-aligned). Pontifex follows the deliberate `mcp-stable` pointer (Codex-endorsed); the pin records whichever tag that pointer resolves to. Reconciliation of the two schemes is co-design.

alignment_policy.follows: mcp-stable pointer (Codex-moved; deliberate production-readiness signal — never auto-follow latest/HEAD)
alignment_policy.additive: minor/patch contract bump → align (fetch + verify sha256 + validate contract version + update pin + acceptance-suite smoke-test + log)
alignment_policy.breaking: major contract bump → gate: halt and re-validate serving-logic before pinning (Pontifex + programme lead)
